description: Experiments C–E: multiple stored tree foci, ordinary leaf connections and shared subtrees. Synthetic data only; no DAG templates or new force laws.
initialJitter: Uniform [-40, 40) per coordinate, from the seeded LCG. Pinned/free runs retain identical starting coordinates.

metrics.angularGapRms: RMS over all angular gaps at vertices of degree >=2 within each stored tree, including deeper branches. Both trees are scored in every mode.
metrics.unionAngularGapRms: Same observable on the deduplicated union of both trees, regardless of activation. At a shared branch, union degree can differ from each individual tree degree.
metrics.radialLengthRms: RMS physical endpoint distance minus 120 over selected tree edges; unionLengthRms counts shared edges once.
metrics.motion: Final 100 actual integration steps, RMS over movable nodes and steps; maximum also retained. A read-only force callback observes nine steps and repaint observes the tenth in every batch.
metrics.unionLengthLowerBound: For a root path with q selected edges among M unique tree edges: max(0, rootSeparation-q*120)/sqrt(q*M). Triangle inequality and Cauchy–Schwarz. Null if no selected root path; a fixed feasibility obstruction only while roots are pinned.
metrics.reversals: Fraction of eligible consecutive movable-node displacements whose dot product is negative; both magnitudes must exceed 0.05. Null if no eligible pair. Diagnostic, not an oscillation spectrum.
